purpose: Characterize a bounded precomputed face representation that composes the qualified dry C1R envelope with a restricted near-saturation/saturated head envelope without extrapolating the C1R log-head coordinate to h=0.

physical_scope.positive_head_scope: restricted transition research only; not groundwater or general saturated-column admission

representation_family.dry_coordinate: u=log10(-h), uniform 241-node axis [0,4], identical to C1R
representation_family.wet_coordinate: w=(h+1)/2, uniform axis for h in [-1,+1] cm
representation_family.generation_rule: Generate Nwet=33 once; Nwet=17 is the exact every-second-node nested subset.
representation_family.stored_quantity: IEEE754 float32 log mobility M=q/g, where g=L+h_above-h_below
representation_family.runtime_interpolation: binary64 bilinear interpolation after promotion of four float32 entries
representation_family.hydrostatic_rule: g=0 returns q=0; hydrostatic node mobility is the positive harmonic-path mobility from the same constitutive law
representation_family.dry_dry_rule: delegate unchanged to qualified C1R; E2A does not regenerate or replace the dry-dry table
representation_family.minus1_seam_rule: Because the dry u-axis and physical node generator are identical to C1R and the wet axis contains h=-1 exactly, the DRY_WET first wet column and WET_DRY first wet row must be node-identical to the corresponding C1R boundary column/row before float32 storage.

saturation_seam_guard.physics_claim: Only C0 flux continuity is required. No unique cross-seam derivative is claimed at h=0.
saturation_seam_guard.candidate_must_not_invent_jump: For paired h=-epsilon/+epsilon probes, the candidate error relative to the steady-Darcy oracle is governed by the ordinary frozen error metrics; no smoothing or modified K(h) is introduced.

selection_rule.pass: Select the smallest Nwet that passes every frozen metric for all six stress materials, then open a fresh 36-material holdout with untouched seeds.
selection_rule.fail: If Nwet=33 fails any frozen metric, reject this direct-h piecewise table representation and open a new representation gate. Do not add nodes or change the coordinate after observing failures inside E2A.

memory_accounting.note: The earlier C1R 256-KiB selection limit is not silently redefined. E2 records its incremental shared-table cost separately; later runtime/MultiSWAP admission must judge the combined shared footprint.

explicit_nonclaims: E2A does not qualify a transient saturation-crossing timestep.
E2A does not qualify h>+1 cm, groundwater, prescribed-head bottom boundaries, heterogeneous faces, Class-B hydraulics, macropores or MultiSWAP performance.
E2A does not modify theta(h), K(h), KSATFIT or the C1R dry-dry representation.
